indicator_name: Total Resident Deposits in Deposit-Taking Organizations
description: Депозиты резидентов в депозитных организациях, всего
methodology: Million KZT, resident deposits in depository organizations, total (M3 - M0), stock at the end of the month, dated as at the first day of the next month; from 1994 (NBK page records). Replaced open-data form 51 on 2026-09-25, whose 2021-12..2022-12 values were wrong.
